name: ferrum_node_agent_ingress_interface_family_required
help: Whether a route family must be covered by the configured interface set.

name: ferrum_node_agent_ingress_interface_topology
help: NodeWaypoint ingress-interface topology validation state and bounded reason.

name: ferrum_node_agent_pod_annotation_updates_applied_total
help: Mid-life pod includeOutboundPorts annotation changes re-applied to the BPF map.

name: ferrum_node_agent_pod_annotation_updates_failed_total
help: Mid-life pod includeOutboundPorts annotation changes that failed to re-apply (annotation parse error or BPF map write error). Cgroup-id-unavailable retries are intentionally not counted here because they are routinely observed during early pod startup and are retried on the next Apply event.

name: ferrum_node_agent_pods_enrolled_total
help: Pods enrolled for node-agent capture.

name: ferrum_node_agent_pods_unenrolled_total
help: Pods unenrolled from node-agent capture.

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_abandoned_at_deadline_total
help: Notification deliveries hard-aborted because the global observability shutdown drain deadline expired; the shutdown_deadline slice of ferrum_notification_delivery_abandoned_total.

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_abandoned_total
help: Notification delivery tasks whose body started executing but settled without a committed outcome, by fixed reason (generation_retired = producer reload/Drop, shutdown_deadline = hard abort at the global drain deadline, task_dropped = dispatch task dropped without settling).

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_attempted_total
help: Notification delivery tasks whose registry-owned delivery body started executing (counted once per admitted task, not once per bounded retry; may advance before any channel transport call).

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_backpressure_dropped_total
help: Notification deliveries dropped because the bounded dispatch semaphore was exhausted.

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_failed_permanent_total
help: Notification deliveries that failed with a permanent (non-retryable) outcome.

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_failed_transient_total
help: Notification deliveries that exhausted retries on transient transport/HTTP failures.

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_in_flight
help: Notification deliveries currently executing (including bounded retry backoff).

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_rejected_total
help: Notification deliveries rejected before the registry-owned delivery body started, by fixed reason (generation_closed = producer reload/Drop closed admission, registry_rejected = process delivery registry refused the task).

name: ferrum_notification_delivery_succeeded_total
help: Notification deliveries that completed successfully (after any bounded retries).

name: ferrum_oauth2_introspection_cache_admission_skips_total
help: OAuth2 introspection results not retained because a bounded cache admission could not complete.

name: ferrum_oauth2_introspection_cache_cleanup_work_total
help: Bounded OAuth2 introspection eviction-index tickets examined.

name: ferrum_oauth2_introspection_cache_entries
help: OAuth2 introspection cache entries retained across live plugin generations.

name: ferrum_oauth2_introspection_cache_evictions_total
help: OAuth2 introspection cache entries evicted by bounded cleanup or capacity admission.

name: ferrum_oauth2_introspection_cache_retained_bytes
help: OAuth2 introspection cache bytes retained across live plugin generations, including fixed eviction indexes.

name: ferrum_observability_batch_materialization_fallbacks_total
help: Batches delivered complete but in a degraded representation, such as uncompressed because the compressed copy could not be reserved. No record loss.

name: ferrum_observability_batch_materialization_losses_total
help: Discard events, each of which lost one or more records.

name: ferrum_observability_batch_materialization_lost_records_total
help: Log entries, spans, and rows discarded because their batch representation could not be materialized under the retained-byte ceiling. Counts records, not reservations.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_active_tasks
help: Deferred observability tasks currently owned by the shutdown lifecycle.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_active_workers
help: Queue workers currently owned by the shutdown lifecycle.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_admitted_tasks
help: Deferred observability tasks holding an admission permit (registry plus in-flight spawn handoff).

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_cancelled_tasks_total
help: Delivery tasks cancelled on shutdown-budget expiry or during spawn/cancel handoff races.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_capacity_rejected_tasks_total
help: Delivery tasks rejected specifically because the aggregate task budget was exhausted.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_drain_timeouts_total
help: Observability shutdown drains that exhausted their shared deadline.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_generation
help: Current delivery lifecycle generation; increments when a serving cycle reopens delivery after a drain.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_lost_worker_records_total
help: Queued records abandoned when worker drain exceeded the shutdown budget.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_max_tasks
help: Configured aggregate admission budget for terminal, mirror, and deadline-cleanup tasks.

name: ferrum_observability_delivery_rejected_tasks_total
help: Delivery tasks rejected after lifecycle admission closed, task-budget exhaustion, or without a runtime.

name: ferrum_observability_max_retained_bytes
help: Configured process-wide retained-byte ceiling shared by all observability sink instances.

name: ferrum_observability_process_ceiling_rejections_total
help: Sink admissions refused specifically by the process-wide retained-byte ceiling rather than a per-instance budget.

name: ferrum_observability_retained_bytes
help: Bytes currently retained across every observability sink instance in this process.

name: ferrum_observability_retained_bytes_high_water
help: Peak process-wide observability retention observed since startup.

name: ferrum_rate_limit_exceeded_total
help: Total rate limit rejections.

name: ferrum_request_duration_ms
help: Request duration in milliseconds.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_budget_drops_total
help: request_mirror attempts dropped because max_retained_request_body_bytes was exhausted.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_cancellations_total
help: request_mirror tasks dropped before a terminal outcome (shutdown/panic/cancellation).

name: ferrum_request_mirror_completed_total
help: request_mirror tasks that fully drained a response within byte and time bounds.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_concurrency_drops_total
help: request_mirror attempts dropped because max_in_flight was saturated.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_dispatched_total
help: request_mirror detached tasks admitted past concurrency and retained-body budgets.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_drain_failures_total
help: request_mirror response-body drain transport failures.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_drain_timeouts_total
help: request_mirror response-body drain deadline expiries.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_drain_truncations_total
help: request_mirror responses truncated at max_response_body_bytes during bounded drain.

name: ferrum_request_mirror_request_failures_total
help: request_mirror pre-response transport failures (DNS, refused, reset, TLS, …).

name: ferrum_request_mirror_request_timeouts_total
help: request_mirror request-phase deadline expiries (connect/headers/body).

name: ferrum_requests_total
help: Total number of requests processed.

name: ferrum_service_discovery_body_budget_rejected_total

name: ferrum_service_discovery_cursor_rollback_total

name: ferrum_service_discovery_provider_normalization_rejected_total

name: ferrum_service_discovery_response_oversized_total
help: Service-discovery HTTP responses rejected for oversized or ambiguous body bounds.

name: ferrum_service_discovery_shared_admission_rejected_total
help: Service-discovery snapshots rejected by shared host/egress target admission.

name: ferrum_stream_connections_total
help: Total stream connections (TCP/UDP).

name: ferrum_stream_disconnects_total
help: Stream disconnects (TCP/UDP) by cause and direction.

name: ferrum_stream_duration_ms
help: Stream connection duration in milliseconds.
